en.title: Eternal Rest
en.bodyMd:
> V. Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord.
> R. And let the perpetual light shine upon them.

And may the souls of all the faithful departed,
through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
Amen.
en.source: EWTN, "Prayer for the Poor Souls in Purgatory", https://www.ewtn.com/catholicism/teachings/prayer-for-the-poor-souls-in-purgatory-163, retrieved 2026-08-22

la.title: Requiem Aeternam
la.bodyMd:
> V. Requiem aeternam dona eis, Domine.
> R. Et lux perpetua luceat eis.

Fidelium animae, per misericordiam Dei,
requiescant in pace.
Amen.
la.source: EWTN, "Prayer for the Poor Souls in Purgatory", https://www.ewtn.com/catholicism/teachings/prayer-for-the-poor-souls-in-purgatory-163, retrieved 2026-08-22

fr.title: Repos éternel
fr.bodyMd:
Donne-leur, Seigneur, le repos éternel.
Et que brille sur eux la lumière de ta face.
Qu'ils reposent en paix.
Amen.
fr.source: Hozana, « La prière du repos éternel (Requiem aeternam) », https://hozana.org/priere/defunts/repos-eternel, retrieved 2026-08-22 — provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md
